name: Onii-chan, Migite no Shiyou o Kinshi Shimasu!
original_name: お兄ちゃん、右手の使用を禁止します！
source:
Hiroto is a student who lives by himself. One day, he injured his right hand while protecting his younger sisters. Luckily it was not serious, but they mistakenly thought it was the opposite?! He was excused from school until it healed, and his imoutos forbade him from using it. Of course, it would be quite inconvenient, so they suggested that they will always be by his side, as his ‘right hand’. From that day on, everything that he did with his right hand was left to his younger sisters: eating, taking a bath, doing groceries, going to the washroom, masturbating… “Leave everything to us, onii-chan!”

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
博人是独自生活的学生。一天，他为了保护妹妹们弄伤了右手。伤势所幸并不严重，但妹妹们误以为情况恰恰相反！在伤势痊愈前，他获准暂时不上学，而妹妹们也禁止他使用右手。当然，这会带来许多不便，于是她们提议一直陪在他身边，成为他的“右手”。从那天起，他原本用右手做的一切都交给妹妹们：吃饭、洗澡、买东西、上厕所、自慰……“哥哥，一切都交给我们吧！”

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
